suspended: If it stays unpaid, your account may be suspended.

failed.subject: Your HatchGrab payment didn’t go through
failed.line1: We couldn’t take {amount} for {truck} today. We’ll try again.
failed.line2: Please update your {method, select, payment_method {payment method} other {card}} by {date} to keep online ordering on.

twoDays.subject: 2 days left to update your {method, select, payment_method {payment method} other {card}}
twoDays.line1: {amount} for {truck} is still unpaid. Update your {method, select, payment_method {payment method} other {card}} by {date}, or online ordering pauses.

oneDay.subject: Update your {method, select, payment_method {payment method} other {card}} by tomorrow
oneDay.line1: {amount} for {truck} is still unpaid. Update your {method, select, payment_method {payment method} other {card}} by tomorrow, or online ordering pauses.

lastDay.subject: Last day to update your {method, select, payment_method {payment method} other {card}}
lastDay.line1: Today is the last day to pay {amount} for {truck}. If it’s still unpaid at midnight, online ordering pauses until you pay.

paused.subject: Online ordering is paused
paused.line1: Online ordering for {truck} is paused because {amount} is unpaid. Pay now and it comes straight back on.
paused.line2: Pay by {date} or your account may be suspended.

trial7.subject: Your free trial ends in 7 days
trial7.line1: Your free trial for {truck} ends on {date}.
trial7.line2: Add a card in Manage › Billing to keep online ordering on.
trial7.plan: After that, {plan} is {price} a month. When your trial ends we charge {amount} for the rest of {month}, then {price} on {nextFirst}.
trial7.planFree: After that, you’re on {plan}, with no monthly fee.
trial7.fee: Our {fee} fee on online orders is charged on the 1st, for the month before.

trial1.subject: Your free trial ends tomorrow
trial1.line1: Your free trial for {truck} ends tomorrow.
trial1.noCard: Add a card or online ordering pauses.
trial1.charge: We’ll charge {amount} for the rest of {month} when your trial ends.
